## Problem

Describe the user or maintainer problem. Explain why the current behavior is insufficient.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the observable result you want, without assuming a particular implementation.

## Alternatives

List alternatives or workarounds you considered and their tradeoffs.

## Scope and compatibility

For template changes, explain why this is a safe default for repositories with different stacks and visibility. Note
any breaking change, migration, new credential, external service, or ongoing maintenance requirement.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State a verifiable outcome.
- [ ] Add any additional required outcomes.

## Additional context

Include related issues, examples, or references.
